text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — policy-engine panic detected while evaluating smart-routing rules. Paging oncall @todd. Autosilence threshold breached for eu-west-1 fallback loop

incidental_note-bot: Detected abnormal rate of fallback->route updates (loop count > 50 in 5m)

Todd: on it. pulling logs now. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform

maria: I see a stacktrace in the policy-engine logs — NullPointer in expr.eval at policy_regex.go:142. Looks like an assumption that `request.metadata.region` is non-null.

alex: that same null deref is causing the policy evaluator to abort and return error -> router uses default fallback policy -> which maps to regional fallback that sometimes retries and re-evaluates the bad policy -> loop.

jess: customer impact? any 5xx or wrong model variants returned?\
sam: alerting CS. Early telemetry shows an uptick in 502/503s for inference requests that hit smart routing (approx 18% error rate for the last 10m). Top affected region: eu-west-1, also some spill to us-west-2 due to routing.\
ops-bot: /incidents create SEV2 policy_engine_panic_1970012345 — owners: @todd, @maria, @alex — severity: partial customer impact — start_ts 1970012345\
Todd: First mitigation: disable smart-routing rule group "region_regex_fallback_v3" to stop repeated evaluation. Running command now:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap smart-routing --type merge -p '{"data":{"region_regex_fallback_v3":"disabled"}}'
```
\
maria: confirming... logs show failures drop immediately after rule disabled. Errors down from 18% -> ~3% in 90s.\
alex: good catch. But disabling will route more traffic to default fallback model variant (gpt-slim-qa-v1) which has lower accuracy — that could cause customer-visible regressions (answers truncated/misrouted). We should pin an alternative safe variant to reduce risk.\
jess: CS note: informing affected enterprise customers (IDs: C-4712, C-1132) — they reported latency spikes and a couple content regressions. Draft message ready, holding for final mitigation decision.\
Todd: Next step: scale policy-engine replicas to reduce warm-start noise and restart to clear corrupted expr cache.\
alex: executing:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy policy-engine --replicas=0 && sleep 10 && kubectl scale deploy policy-engine --replicas=3
```
\
ops-bot: roll command executed by @alex at 1970012600\
maria: policy-engine restarted across 3 pods. Post-restart logs show the expression parser throwing a parse error on one rule: `(?P<region>[^/]+)?` — optional named group not handled by current parser version (v1.8).\
alex: identifying offending rule in repo: smart-routing/policies/region_regex_fallback_v3.yaml line 27. It uses PCRE tokens that our engine doesn't support. That caused a panic when it hit certain metadata shapes.\
Todd: plan: 1) Re-enable a safe, sanitized version of the rule (strip optional groups) and 2) ship a hotfix to the expression parser to gracefully return an evaluation error instead of panicking. Which do we do first?\
maria: sanitize+apply safe rule now. I'll patch the config in-place to avoid full rollout:
```
kubectl -n inference apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: smart-routing
data:
  region_regex_fallback_v3: "^(eu\-|us\-|ap\-)[a-z0-9]+$"
EOF
```
\
sam: CS update: telling customers we've mitigated the immediate outage by routing to safe variant. Tickets updated with workaround and ETA for full root cause fix.\
ops-bot: telemetry update: error rate back to baseline (~0.8%). Some customers still seeing degraded content quality due to fallback variant.\
jess: we should revert routing to the recommended variant `gpt-lucid-2` for enterprise customers only — can we do a scoped override?\
alex: yes, we can set a per-tenant override in routing table for enterprise tenants while we fix parser. Doing it for C-4712 and C-1132 quickly:
```
redwoodctl routing override add --tenant C-4712 --model gpt-lucid-2 --until 1970018000
redwoodctl routing override add --tenant C-1132 --model gpt-lucid-2 --until 1970018000
```
\
maria: overrides applied. CS confirms improved outputs for both tenants.\
Todd: full root cause: expression parser didn't handle optional named groups resulting in a nil reference during AST walk. Fix path: update parser library to v1.9 with safe node traversal + additional fuzzing for unsupported constructs. I'll own the PR and tests.\
alex: timeline?\
Todd: hotfixPR opened, tests added for regex dialects, will cut a canary build for eng-runtime in 2h and promote if green.\
ops-bot: oncall handoff note: @todd will remain primary until 1970015600, after that handoff to @maria for postmortem and followup.\
maria: postmortem action items: 1) Add validation to policy upload to reject unsupported regex patterns 2) Improve fallback policy to avoid routing thrashed regions 3) Add per-rule circuit breaker to stop repeated evaluations after N errors 4) Add better telemetry to surface regex parse failures earlier.\
sam: CS action items: proactive outreach to 12 customers that hit fallback path more than 10 times; offer credit and summary once postmortem is ready.\
jess: ops follow-ups: add a temporary guard in router to stop retries on policy-eval errors; deploy within next 4h.\
Todd: summarizing mitigation: disabled problematic rule -> restarted policy-engine -> applied sanitized regex -> applied tenant overrides for high-value customers -> opened hotfix PR for parser. System stable.\
maria: leaving logs & diagnostics in incident ticket INC-1970012345. Will start postmortem draft in #postmortems later today.\
incident-bot: Incident closed to active page at 1970014567 — moving to monitoring for 6h. If error rate exceeds threshold reopen. :white_check_mark:
